activities.title: The element should match the job
activities.instruction: Compose your response below, then submit to compare with the reference guide.

content.prompt:

Forge Academy

Learn frontend engineering.

View the curriculum ``` The names are not random. They communicate the role of each piece.
guidelines: State your reasoning clearly in your own words or code.

activities.title: A heading is not just big text

content.title: A heading is not just big text
content.text:
Look at these two choices: ```html

Frontend Engineering

``` and ```html

Frontend Engineering

``` They contain the same words. They do not communicate the same meaning. The first says “this is a paragraph.” The second says “this is the page’s top-level heading.”

content.question: Which is the better choice for the title of a page about HTML?

feedback.correct: Use the element whose meaning matches the content. A page heading is a heading.
feedback.incorrect: Use the element whose meaning matches the content. A page heading is a heading.

content.title: Use the content model
content.text:
You need to add this sentence: ```text HTML gives the page structure. ``` Which is the most direct representation? ```html

HTML gives the page structure.

``` Now add a heading above it: ```html

How HTML Works

HTML gives the page structure.

``` Notice the relationship: the heading introduces the section; the paragraph explains it.

content.question:
A developer chooses elements only because they “look close enough.”

Why is that a weak habit?

options.text: The browser will refuse to load the page.
The HTML stops communicating what the content actually is.
Every page must use one element only.

feedback.correct: Good HTML is meaningful structure. Visual similarity is not the same thing as semantic meaning.
feedback.incorrect: Good HTML is meaningful structure. Visual similarity is not the same thing as semantic meaning.

content.question:
You are given three requirements:

- “This is the page’s main heading.”
- “This is explanatory text.”
- “This takes the user to another location.”

Which set fits those jobs?

feedback.correct: The correct element is the one whose meaning matches the requirement.
feedback.incorrect: The correct element is the one whose meaning matches the requirement.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** HTML elements are vocabulary. Choose a word that tells the truth about the content.
**Senior habit:** When reviewing HTML, ask “What does this content mean?” before asking “How does it look?”
nextSteps: Complete the lesson activities and demonstrate the target skill without relying on unseen concepts from later modules.
